Job Description

Key Responsibilities

This role could be based in China or Hong Kong. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.

Strategy

  • Support management of Markets’ consumption of SCB’s binding Balance Sheet Metrics including LCR, NSFR, RWA and Intragroup Large exposure
  • Identity and facilitate Balance Sheet Optimisation initiatives
  • Be informed of existing and new rules and regulations on Capital, Liquidity and Margining and understand impact on Markets business
  • Within the business mandate, support unique funding asks which TM may be unable to provide, to better serve our clients

Business

  • Support Markets’ balance sheet planning by actively communicates with Markets Trading Desks and Sales to manage Market’s funding pipeline and work with Treasury and FRM to better manage Markets’ funding ask.
  • Facilitate liquidity profile optimisation for Markets business within risk limit and MAT
  • Support Markets’ overall balance sheet management and helps Markets to minimize regulatory liquidity and capital cost.
  • Consistently works with the business and Treasury to optimize liquidity, balance sheet and inventory

Processes

  • Manage daily funding activities in China within the country’s overall Markets funding framework; partner with Treasury China to simplify and streamline process/policy for robust governance and reporting
  • Arrange funding transactions according to Markets internal funding booking model including derivatives collateral margining funding
  • Facilitate optimisation of funding mix including swap funding and other hedging as required, operating within market risk and any other related risk metrics

People and Talent

  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.

Risk Management

  • Responsible to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
  • Responsible to manage market risk and pnl arising from funding and corresponding hedging transactions including FX and interest rate derivatives. Ensure to operate within dealing mandate and all relevant risk limit.

Governance

  • Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group's arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory and Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills and Experience

  • Dealing experience in financial instruments e.g. FX swaps, interest rate swaps
  • Competency in analysing market risk and PNL on trading positions
  • Knowledge and understanding of key balance sheet metrics (LCR, NSFR, leverage ratio, RWA etc)

Qualifications

  • Graduate qualifications (or conversions): Post-Graduate qualifications such as MBA, CFA, Chartered Accountancy, Mathematics/ Statistics, Qualified Lawyer
  • Over 2 to10 years (Analyst to Director) of relevant experience in the banking and financial services industry with hands on experience of underwriting, managing, and recovering credit exposures across both developing and developed jurisdictions
  • Good knowledge of Global Markets businesses and balance sheet management; including market and regulatory dynamics
  • Experience in funding activities related derivatives trading and related PnL and market risk management

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Profile Description

Standard Chartered Bank

Principal Responsibilities

  • Handle all trade finance transactions for DBS clients including OA Finance and Draft transactions

处理星展银行客户的所有应收应付账款融资业务和票据融资业务。

  • Support bank’s project management of the trade service product processing optimization, especially AI projects UR analysis, design, testing & launch

支持银行贸易服务产品及流程及系统优化项目，重点支持AI项目相关的需求分析、设计测试，上线等环节。

  • Backup handle import & export L/Cs, DA/DP, bank guarantee and relevant finances for DBS clients.

候补处理星展客户的国际贸易融资业务包括银行保函，进出口信用证，托收以及相关融资业务.

  • Check supporting docs according to bank’s guidance/trade finance procedure and ensure applications compliance with internal control requirement as well as compliance requirement.

根据银行的操作指引以及贸易融资的操作流程审核相关证明文件，以确保交易申请符合银行内控和合规要求。

  • Checking trade finance documents according to UCP/URDG/ISBP/URR and other international trade finance practice.

根据相关国际惯例审核贸易融资单据.

  • Booking trade finance and relevant funds disbursement in banking system and make data information verification. Process cash margin, BAD/CAD pledge on transactional basis.

将相关贸易融资以及资金的转移收付录入银行系统并确保数据准确性, 根据流程处理交易层面的客户保证金和质押票据的收付.

  • Conduct post checking/monitoring of trade related supporting documents which shall be align with “3 measures & 1 guideline”.

根据”3个办法一个指引” 的要求进行贷后文件的跟踪和审核.

  • Handle DBS client inquiry on trade finance related transactions.

处理星展客户关于贸易融资业务的查询/咨询.

  • Make sure any deviations/irregulars were raised to Team head, and obtain proper DOA approval on exceptions.

确保任何异常交易被上报给部门主管，并且在处理异例前得到相应的授权。

  • Conduct regulatory, MIS and other internal/external reporting for trade finance business i.e.SAFE/UPRR/RCPMIS/FTZMIS etc.

及时提交对内对外相关报表.

  • Assist team head to improve/maintain internal and external audit score, and make sure no significant finding during assessment.

协助部门主管/经理共同达到集团内部审计和外部审计的评定要求，并在规定时间内完成整改要求。

  • Participate in bank’s training if necessary.

积极参与银行相关培训.

Education And Relevant Experience

  • Bachelor degree holder or above.
  • CDCS certificate/CSDG certificate
  • Minimum 5 years experience in Trade Finance operations including OA Finance, Draft and Import/export Trade Finance.

Functional / Technical Competencies

  • Good knowledge on Trade Finance and related rules, regulation and practice,
  • In-depth knowledge on trade related international rules, regulations and practices
  • Basic knowledge of accounting
  • Proficient in commonly used data analysis software e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, R, Python, etc.
  • Good data visualization skills: Ability to create clear, concise, and insightful charts and reports
  • Good PC skills and good command of English and Mandarin.
  • Good communication skill and problem solving skill.
  • Capable to work effectively under pressure and tight deadline

Location:

PRC - Shanghai

Job:

Operations

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

Job Summary

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

People & Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 10+ years’ experience in Strong software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design
  • Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Job Summary

Scope of Role:

Account for branch’s operations; counter transactions including system operations to ensure execution accuracy, compliance, and completeness in line with bank internal and external rules/procedures/manuals/standards/group requirements/regulatory requirement/laws as well as to keep high class level of services to our clients

职责范围：

负责分支行的业务操作及各项与分支行有关的营运工作，包括柜台交易的办理及系统处理，确保各项分支行工作执行的准确性，合规性和完整性，执行中必须始终遵守并严格按照银行的内外部准则/操作流程/操作手册/标准/集团要求/监管要求/法规等要求，同时始终保持高水准的客户服务质量与体验

Key Responsibilities

General 总则

Job Purpose

The Project Manager for Wealth Management Technology (WMT) is responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and successful delivery of technology projects within the Wealth Management domain. This role ensures projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards, aligning with business objectives and contributing to the bank's strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Alignment:

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering, BA and Tech Leads to define scope, timelines, and budgets.
  • Drive weekly Capacity/prioritization meeting with Business.

Delivery Oversight & Risk Management:

  • Track progress, ensure adherence to timelines and budgets, and mitigate risks proactively.
  • Protect timelines and scope by challenging the business, when necessary, with support from key stakeholders.
  • Plan and manage releases, including dependencies across subsystems and teams and ensure delivery plans for all assigned squads align seamlessly with overall initiative release timelines.

Medium – Long Term Work Funnel Management:

  • Engage with Regional Wealth Platform to understand new initiatives, manage T-shirt sizing, and High-Level Estimates (HLEs).

Financial & Resource Management:

  • Plan and track the budget for initiatives under their purview

Production Incident Management (Coordination):

  • Partner with SRE and Platform teams to coordinate the effective addressal of critical production issues and incidents related to initiatives and modules owned by their respective squads, ensuring timely resolution and communication.
  • Plan on SRE familiarization on new launched features.

Continuous Improvement & Performance:

  • Foster continuous improvement in delivery processes across their assigned squads, emphasizing overall team performance, quality outcomes, adoption of best practices, and actively work to eliminate toil and drive towards greater efficiency.

Requirements

Experience:

  • Proven experience as a Project Manager, preferably within the financial services or banking industry, with a focus on technology projects.
  • Experience in Wealth Management, Client Channels or related domains is highly desirable.

Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., JIRA ).

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Technology

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

Job Summary

We are inviting a passionate software developer to be part of an exciting journey within the Wealth banking space and one of the leading global banks.

You will be a front-end developer, working as an Individual Contributor (no people leadership responsibility), which means that you are an expert and hands-on front-end developer. You will be a member of a squad and will also work closely with the Product Owners and influence the direction and roadmap of the product you are working on.

Although you may have a preferred language and framework to work with, we love to keep an open mind. With Standard Chartered, you will have the opportunity to learn new techniques, programming languages and frameworks to get the job done.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy

Business

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

Processes

  • Challenge the “as is” way of working across delivery, governance, operational model/structure
  • Apply depth of analytical understanding of a variety of New Ways of Working such as problem solving, Extreme Programming, Behaviour Driven Development, DevOps,.
  • Understand what practice, tool or technique to apply given the environment and the situation is the challenge that you will need to demonstrate mastery in using a show/tell/do approach

People & Talent

  • Lead by example and build the appropriate culture and values.
  • As expert developer, you will coach other team members “on the job” and manage by influence, as you will not have any direct reports assigned to you.

Risk Management

  • Lead to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • Product Owners, Chief Product Owners

Skills And Experience

  • JavaScript/TypeScript
  • ReactJS or any other Front-end Framework
  • Source Code Management
  • RDBMS and No-SQL

Qualifications

  • Languages: Fluent in spoken and written English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Syndicate and Portfolio Management Graduate Programme 2027 

On our Syndicate & Portfolio Management Graduate Programme, you'll gain exposure to how large-scale financing is structured, distributed and managed across global markets. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you'll develop an understanding of credit, risk and portfolio management while helping to support clients and drive business growth across some of the world's most dynamic markets.

About the Graduate Programme – how you’ll learn and grow

Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background. Over our two-year graduate programme, you’ll gain hands-on experience, build lasting relationships and grow your understanding of clients, markets and the wider business. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work and be supported to build a successful long-term career.

You’ll Benefit From

  • Real impact: Take ownership of meaningful work that contributes to business outcomes.
  • Future-ready capabilities: Build the technical, commercial and professional skills needed to succeed.
  • Global collaboration: Work with colleagues and clients across markets, products and functions.
  • Continuous growth: Learn from structured development, mentoring and practical experience.

Where you could work 

You’ll be placed into one of the following teams: 

  • Credit Portfolio Analytics - Manages how the Bank uses its financial resources and credit portfolio, balancing risk and returns to support sustainable growth and make effective use of capital and funding.
  • Credit Portfolio Management - Provides data-driven analysis and insights to support informed decision-making, helping the Bank understand its clients, credit portfolio, and identify opportunities to improve performance and returns.
  • Syndicate and Financing Risk - Supports the structuring, pricing, risk management and distribution of loans and bonds, helping the Bank provide financing to clients while effectively managing risk and returns.

Bring the skills - we’ll help you build your career

We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.

We’re Looking For People Who Can

  • Take ownership and show initiative when tackling challenges
  • Think critically, solve problems and apply sound judgement.
  • Learn quickly, Stay curious and look for opportunities to grow and develop
  • Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others
  • Adapt and perform in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrate commercial curiosity, with an interest in clients, markets and global trends.

For technical roles, we particularly value backgrounds in Finance & Banking, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics and Statistics.

Eligibility

To be eligible for this graduate programme, you need to be in your final year of study and graduating by July 2027. You must also have the permanent legal right to work in the country you’re applying to.

You can only submit one application within a six-month period, so take time to review our opportunities and apply for the role that best fits your interests, skills and career goals.

Key Dates

  • Assessment Centres: November 2026 onwards
  • Start Date: July 2027

About Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB)

We are a super-connector for many of the world’s largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth. We work with governments, financial institutions, and some of the world’s most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest, and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.

What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory, and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it’s needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint.

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: HASE Technology

Job ID: 63997

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead cloud data product development: define product boundaries, data contracts, SLAs/SLOs, and consumption patterns for Finance/Risk users and downstream systems.
  • Design and build cloud data products (curated datasets/semantic layers/marts as applicable) using strong modelling practices and reusable engineering patterns.
  • Be hands-on: develop, review and maintain production-grade code using advanced SQL and Python; mentor engineers/analysts.
  • Establish strong data quality and control framework: profiling, rules, exception handling, reconciliation, and “source-to-target” validation with traceable evidence.
  • Apply cloud data architecture principles: security-by-design (IAM, encryption, secrets), non-functional requirements, observability/monitoring, and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with other data teams (Business, Finance, Risk and Technology) on data governance, metadata/lineage, data standards and stewardship, and product adoption—ensuring data products are discoverable, trusted, and consistently used across the bank.
  • Support production operations: monitoring/alerting, incident/problem management, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of reliability.

Requirements

  • Degree holder (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years’ experience delivering data projects (data engineering / data product development), including building and deploying cloud-based data pipelines and curated datasets for enterprise use.
  • Proven Technical Lead experience delivering cloud-based data products or data engineering solutions (design authority + hands-on build).
  • Strong hands-on skills: advanced SQL plus Python (basic working proficiency) for transformations, validations and automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud data architecture: data modelling, integration patterns, security, scalability, resilience, and cost/performance optimisation.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and technology delivery practices (e.g., version control, code review, environment management).
  • Experience implementing data governance and controls (lineage, auditability, approvals/evidence) in a regulated environment.
  • Finance and Risk domain knowledge is required; experience delivering data solutions for Finance and/or Risk functions.
  • Fluent spoken Cantonese; strong written English for technical documentation and stakeholder communications.
  • Strong risk and control mindset; able to maintain audit-ready artefacts.
  • Cloud/data engineering/architecture certifications (Azure/AWS/GCP).
  • Experience with data observability/DQ tooling, metadata/lineage tooling
  • Exposure to regulatory programmes, data remediation, Finance/Risk reporting, or End User Computing remediation.

/WX/ZP

Job Summary

This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of trade transactions across the end-to-end trade lifecycle. The role safeguards operational integrity by overseeing trade documentation, transaction processing, compliance controls and exception management while supporting efficient trade servicing for clients and stakeholders.

The role is accountable for delivering consistent operational outcomes that meet regulatory requirements, internal policies and client expectations. It works closely with front office, compliance, risk, technology and operations teams to ensure trade transactions are executed with appropriate controls, risks are identified and mitigated, and operational issues are resolved effectively.

Through ongoing workflow analysis, process optimisation and operational governance, the role contributes to improved service quality, stronger risk management, enhanced client satisfaction and a scalable operating environment that supports business growth across trade products and markets.

Key Responsibilities

Trade Transaction Execution & Operations Control

  • Manage the end-to-end processing of trade transactions to ensure accuracy, timeliness and adherence to operational standards.
  • Oversee trade documentation and transaction records to support effective execution and audit readiness.
  • Maintain operational controls that minimise processing errors and support consistent trade settlement outcomes.
  • Resolve transaction-related issues and exceptions to reduce operational disruption and client impact.

Trade Documentation & Verification

  • Govern trade documentation processes to ensure completeness, accuracy and compliance with applicable requirements.
  • Verify trade-related information and supporting documentation to facilitate efficient transaction processing.
  • Strengthen document validation controls that reduce operational risks and prevent processing delays.
  • Maintain high-quality record management practices that support regulatory, audit and internal review requirements.

Risk, Compliance & Fraud Prevention

  • Apply regulatory and policy requirements to trade activities to ensure compliant operational execution.
  • Identify, assess and escalate operational risks, control weaknesses and compliance concerns in a timely manner.
  • Support fraud detection and prevention activities through effective transaction monitoring and investigation.
  • Partner with risk and compliance teams to strengthen controls and address emerging regulatory requirements.

Operational Efficiency & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyse operational workflows to identify improvement opportunities that enhance productivity and reduce cycle times.
  • Drive operational process enhancements that improve service delivery, control effectiveness and scalability.
  • Monitor operational performance metrics and exception trends to support informed decision-making.
  • Implement sustainable solutions that improve process consistency and reduce recurring issues.

Stakeholder & Client Service Management

  • Collaborate with business, risk, compliance and technology partners to support seamless trade execution.
  • Manage stakeholder engagement to ensure effective resolution of operational issues and service requests.
  • Contribute to positive client outcomes through efficient transaction handling and responsive issue management.
  • Support business objectives by providing operational insights and recommendations on trade process performance.

Motivations

  • Motivated by delivering accurate, controlled and reliable operational outcomes in complex environments.
  • Energised by solving operational challenges and collaborating with diverse stakeholders to achieve shared objectives.
  • Thrives in environments that value accountability, continuous improvement and high standards of client service.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Trade Finance
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
  • Trade Reconciliation
  • Quality Assurance
  • System Implementation
  • Banking Operations Management
  • Business Communications

Other Skills

  • Change Management
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Talent Development
  • Project Coordination

Qualifications

  • Exposure to regulated financial services environments where accuracy, control and compliance are critical.
  • Exposure to complex trade processing activities involving multiple stakeholders, systems and operational dependencies.
  • Experience managing operational risks, transaction exceptions and process control requirements within high-volume environments.
  • Exposure to operational improvement initiatives focused on enhancing efficiency, service quality and risk management.
  • Experience collaborating across business, risk, compliance and technology teams to support effective trade execution.
  • Business English (required)

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Job Description

Job responsibilities:

  • Lead the team to perform end-to-end middle office operations including but not limited to trade settlement, cash clearing handling, front office support, asset servicing management and vendor oversight.
  • Collaborate with various stakeholders (portfolio managers, compliance, controls, risk, client service, operations, internal and external service providers) to design and drive comprehensive solutions that meet business requirements.
  • Oversee offshored and outsourced activity whilst ensuring performance and service levels are met.
  • Partner with internal and external teams to set up new products in internal system or with external counterparties.
  • Establish areas of improvement and implement new procedures and change existing process flows to ensure tight controls front to back.
  • Manage projects and initiatives, such as process improvement, business model changes, system implementation, new product or new market initiatives rollouts, and other ad hoc projects.
  • 领导团队执行端到端中台业务，包括但不限于交易结算、现金清算处理、前台支持、资产服务管理和供应商监督。
  • 与各种利益相关者（投资组合经理、合规、控制、风险、客户服务、运营、内部和外部服务提供商）合作，设计和推动满足业务需求的综合解决方案。
  • 监督离岸和外包活动，同时确保其能达到性能和服务水平。
  • 与内部和外部团队开展合作，并在内部系统中与外部交易对手创建新产品。
  • 建立改进领域，实施新程序并更改现有流程，以确保从前到后严格控制。
  • 负责管理项目和计划，例如流程改进、业务模式变更、系统实施、新产品或新市场计划推出以及其他临时项目。

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • 10+ years of relevant work experience in the asset management industry or a related industry, ideally with exposure to settlement or trading support, ETF Operations and broker KYC process;
  • Hold AMAC qualification
  • High level of attention to detail and ability to resolve conflicting priorities;
  • Exceptional expertise in the investment market, with a strong understanding of the evolving market structure and regulatory environment;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both internal and external stakeholders;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and hybrid environment, a “can do” attitude and the willingness to learn new applications in an ever-changing environment;
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills in Mandarin and English;
  • Knowledge of markets products (Equities/ Fixed Income/ FX/ Fund of fund/ Money Market) and associated pre/post trade operational processes with specific functional expertise in one of Middle office, settlements or asset services for equities/fixed income is highly desirable.
  • 10 年以上资产管理行业或相关行业相关工作经验，最好具备结算或交易支持、ETF 运营和经纪人 KYC 流程方面的经验。
  • 持有基金业从业资格。
  • 高度关注细节并有能力解决相互冲突的优先事项。
  • 在投资市场拥有卓越的专业知识，对不断变化的市场结构和监管环境有深刻的了解。
  • 出色的沟通和人际交往能力，能够与内部和外部利益相关者有效联络。
  • 能够在快节奏的混合环境中工作，具有“可以做”的态度，并愿意在不断变化的环境中学习新应用。
  • 具备有效的普通话和英语书面和口头沟通能力。
  • 非常需要了解市场产品（股票/固定收益/外汇/基金/货币市场基金）以及相关的交易前/交易后运营流程，以及股票/固定收益的中间办事处、结算或资产服务方面的特定职能专长。

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.
